hypothesis: Doubling the query tile from 64 rows / 128 threads to 128 rows / 256 threads raises attention occupancy from 4 to 8 warps per SM (shared memory stays at one block per SM) and reads each K/V tile once for 128 queries instead of 64, while leaving every query row's 32-key walk and bfloat16 rounding unchanged, so outputs stay bit-identical.
independent_variable: Only the attention launch tile: flash_kernel<64,128> versus flash_kernel<128,256> in attention.cu. Same 32-key K tiles, same tile order, same online-softmax recurrence, same epilogue, same inputs, same stream, same buffers.

shared.heads: Hq=24, Hk=4, head_dim=256 (Qwen3.5-27B full-attention shape), ldv=Hk*head_dim
shared.inputs: Seeded (mt19937 20261101) incompressible random bfloat16 bytes, one allocation per tensor reused by both arms; kernel-level arms write to separate output buffers, library-level runs write the same file path per revision
shared.cache: warm; no cache drops, no clock changes
shared.stream: one non-blocking stream per process; 1 excluded warmup pair per length before timing
shared.protocol: interleaved A B B A per repetition, 10 repetitions per length, each sample is the mean of 5 launches timed with two CUDA events; medians reported; two independent processes (trials) per device, run back to back
shared.parity: old and new outputs compared byte for byte at every measured length, plus prefix windows at q_base 64/128/1024 against the full pass

runs.host: single-GPU rented CUDA 12.1 host, 8 CPU / 32 GiB

run_budget: Kernel-level: 10 A-B-B-A repetitions per length per trial, two trials per device; no extra repetitions added after seeing results. Library-level: 10 batches of 5 calls per revision per trial, two trials per device. Quality gate runs once per device before timing.

acceptance.fidelity: Every measured length and every prefix window is byte-identical between arms; compute-sanitizer reports 0 errors; tests/qwen3_5/kernels.rs attention tests pass with the candidate active.
acceptance.latency: Median library-level call time strictly lower for every enabled length on each measured device, with the 512-row point unchanged because it stays on the 64-row tile. No length may regress.
acceptance.scope: Enabled only on sm_89 and sm_120 with a 640-row window minimum; other devices, the shared-prefix kernel, H200/sm_90 and end-to-end serving are out of scope and unverified.

stop: Stop on any parity mismatch or sanitizer error, or after the declared budget.

revisions.candidate_patch: working tree against base_git_sha: src/backends/cuda/qwen3_5/attention.cu, src/backends/cuda/qwen3_5/README.md
revisions.harness: harness/attn_record.cu (kernel arms), harness/attn_lib_record.cu (public entry point), harness/attn_prefix_check.cu (prefix windows)

records.kernel_samples: results_<device>.jsonl (kind=sample, 20 samples per arm and length per trial)
records.parity: parity_<device>.log and the byte comparisons recorded in summary.json
